load.quote: You’ll supersize the fun when you attach the Easy 3 sidecar. The sidecar weighs 42 pounds and adds another 150 pounds of payload capacity, raising the combined e-bike and sidecar capacity to 450 pounds. Assembling the sidecar and attaching the connection plate to the side of the e-bike wasn’t difficult, but it took the better part of an hour, although I’m admittedly both clumsy and overly cautious.
